# Cluster and block bootstraps of the paper's interval claims (generated by code/bootstrap_robust.py)

1000 resamples per scheme. Δ = I_method / I_LGB-Q − 1 (%), 95% percentile interval. 'holds' = interval excludes zero in the claimed direction. Store-level clusters on M5 (10) are too few for reliable intervals.
